scope: CoreAudio system playback keeps a small backward running-clock reading unknown

observed_failure.shape: A raw sample time one to two frames behind the last accepted reading, with no discontinuity, after substantial playback
observed_failure.source_format: 44100 Hz stereo converted by the system queue to a 48000 Hz stereo device

policy.tolerated_retreat: floor(last) - floor(sample) <= 1 for ordinary running progress reads
policy.effect: The reading stays unknown; no payload retires, no enqueue credit releases, and the five-second deadline still applies
policy.basis: Earph policy; Apple documents no monotonicity guarantee for this reading

verification.regression_red: Both running_clock_retreat tests failed on macOS for their intended assertions before the correction

limits: Real headphone playback with the corrected Engine is unverified.
The macOS wiring that selects the progress purpose has no direct test; only the pure decision is tested.
A retreat after the source finishes still faults the output.
No device, timing, or acoustic qualification follows from this record.
